response.sql: WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) as project_count FROM scanspatial ss INNER JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(project_count)::NUMERIC as total_count, AVG(project_count)::NUMERIC as avg_count FROM funding_counts) SELECT fc.fundflux as funding_source, fc.project_count as count, fc.project_count::NUMERIC / t.total_count as share, fc.project_count::NUMERIC - t.avg_count as excess_over_average FROM funding_counts fc CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE fc.project_count > t.avg_count
